svg.title: Water treatment operator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as water treatment operator, wearing coveralls and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A tall rounded water-filter vessel has three separated media layers and an outlet above one clean-water drop. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
